mapper.insert: insert into clazz (name, room, begin_date, end_date, master_id, subject, create_time, update_time) values (#{name}, #{room}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{masterId}, #{subject}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update:
update clazz
name = #{name}, room = #{room}, begin_date = #{beginDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, master_id = #{masterId},
subject = #{subject},
where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select c.* ,emp.name masterName, case when c.create_time >= NOW() then '未开班' when c.end_date <= NOW() then '结课' else '在读中' end as status from clazz c left join emp on c.master_id = emp.id
and c.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and end_date between #{begin} and #{end}
order by update_time desc
